nodes.label: Code graph (docs/graph.md)
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before reading a monolith end to end: it answers what calls this, what breaks if I change this and how two symbols connect in under a second, with file and line.

nodes.label: Using it (graphify commands)
nodes.rationale: Name a symbol qualified by its file because cited functions also have stub nodes under docs/graph.md, so a bare name can be ambiguous; query matches keywords and can miss the code you mean.

nodes.label: Docs pass (language model links docs to code)
Blind spots
nodes.rationale: The structure pass cannot see HTTP links between browser and server or symbols inside IIFE-wrapped scripts, so the page records them by hand and the docs pass picks them up.

nodes.label: Front end as an island (HTTP-only link to server)
Refreshing the graph
nodes.rationale: The semantic cache is committed and keyed by file content so extract sends only changed docs to the model (first full doc pass read 550,000 tokens).

nodes.label: How browser API paths are built
HTTP routes no browser code calls
nodes.rationale: CLI and MCP tools run commands in process, so these routes serve outside HTTP API clients with bearer tokens.

nodes.label: graphify (PyPI graphifyy)
nodes.rationale: graphify is a development tool and never a weave dependency.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Without it public/vendor/mermaid.min.js alone adds 3,203 nodes and fake hubs named t() and r().
